source.text: Stage III or IV pathologically proven NSCLC with advanced or metastatic disease
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-2

currently on treatment with an Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved single agent monoclonal antibody inhibiting the PD(L)-1 pathway (pembrolizumab, atezolizumab, nivolumab, or cemiplimab) for a minimum of 12 weeks
Treatment within the previous 6 weeks or planned initiation of bevacizumab
History of active primary immunodeficiency or active infection including tuberculosis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C
